welcome:
Welcome to MailHub! 👋

Manage multiple mailboxes right inside Telegram.
Connect Gmail or Yandex, get smart notifications, and read messages without leaving the chat.
choose_provider: Which mail provider would you like to connect?
auth_instructions:
Tap the button below to authorize MailHub.

We only request read access — we never send mail on your behalf.
auth_link_sent: Authorization link is ready. Tap the button below to continue. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth_expired: This authorization link has expired. Please start over.
account_connected:
✅ Account {email} connected!

New emails will be summarized here automatically.
account_disconnected: Account {email} has been disconnected. Its messages were removed.
confirm_unlink: Disconnect account {email}? You will stop receiving notifications.
no_accounts: No connected accounts yet. Use /start to connect one.
help: 🤖 MailHub Help • /start — connect a mailbox and set up the bot • /accounts — manage connected accounts • /settings — open settings • /help — this help What MailHub can do: • Read Gmail and Yandex inboxes (read-only) • Send instant notifications about new mail • Categorize mail into Important / Promo / Spam • Let you read messages in the Mini App Mail is never sent from your accounts. Tokens are encrypted.
settings_hint: Open the Mini App to change language, polling interval, and notification categories:
oauth_invalid_state: Invalid or expired authorization link. Please start over from the bot.
account_deactivated: ⚠️ Account {email} hit repeated sync errors and was deactivated. Please reconnect it.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
